name: bybit-mcp
description: Bybit (Unified) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles, get_balances, list_orders, pla

platform_mcp_bybit_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_API_KEY
platform_mcp_bybit_api_key.description: Bybit API key (system-generated HMAC key) with Read + Trade (Spot/Contract) and NO Wallet/Transfer/Withdraw permission. Testnet keys come from https://testnet.bybit.com and work only against https://api-testnet.bybit.com (set adapter.base_url to it).

platform_mcp_bybit_api_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_API_SECRET
platform_mcp_bybit_api_secret.description: The key's secret: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + api_key + recv_window (5000) + query string (GET) or JSON body (POST), sent as X-BAPI-SIGN. Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_bybit_category.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BYBIT_CATEGORY
platform_mcp_bybit_category.description: Bybit product category every tool works on: `spot` or `linear` (USDT/USDC perpetuals and futures).

tools.name: me
tools.description: API key information: readOnly, permissions (check that Wallet/Withdraw is empty), ips, uta, isMaster.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Instruments of the configured category in one call (spot has no pagination; linear is asked for 1000, the maximum; further cursor pages are not fetched). `query` is not sent.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Decimal strings passed through; price24hPcnt is a fraction (-0.0126 = -1.26%).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Intervals 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,6h,12h,1d,1w,1M. Rows come NEWEST FIRST; `time` is the start time in ms (string) and values are decimal strings. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Unified trading account, non-zero coins only; account totals (totalEquity, totalAvailableBalance) are in each row's context under the raw response.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Open orders (first 50). For `linear` Bybit needs a symbol or settle coin, so settleCoin=USDT is sent: pass `symbol` for USDC contracts. `status` is not sent.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS on the configured host; it is not a simulation. Test with the Bybit testnet https://api-testnet.bybit.com first (edit adapter.base_url to point there), and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. On `linear` this opens or adds to a LEVERAGED position. `quantity` is in the base coin (spot market orders are sent with marketUnit=baseCoin; Bybit's own default for spot market buys is quote coin). Limit orders rest GTC (Bybit's default) and need `price`. Creation is asynchronous: status `submitted` means accepted, check list_orders.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Bybit requires `symbol` with the order id; cancellation is asynchronous.
